guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：同態加密運算服務
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Homomorphic-encryption computing services
guides.concept: 以密文代數、噪聲預算與精度管理串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect ciphertext algebra, noise budgets and precision with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「明密文邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：同態運算保護處理中資料但允許解密結果可見。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫資料持有者、運算者及結果接收者。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「安全參數」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：多項式維度與密文模數需共同滿足安全估計。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「讀正式參數列而不將玩具值當安全配置。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「重線性化」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：重線性化縮減密文大小但不消除全部誤差。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫乘法前後項數及評価金鑰角色。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「多項式近似」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：非多項式函式需定義逼近區間與誤差。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較 toy sigmoid 近似在範圍內外的誤差。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「模數迴繞」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：模整數結果需和業務可表示範圍一致。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「重算本課 Z17 加乘與一般整數的差別。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「輸出最小化」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：加密過程不阻止合法結果透露敏感統計。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較完整預測向量與聚合輸出的需求。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for plain/cipher boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Homomorphic computation protects processing while allowing result decryption. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw data owner, evaluator and result recipient. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for security parameters. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Polynomial dimension and ciphertext modulus jointly affect security estimates. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Read standard tables without treating toy values as secure. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for relinearization. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Relinearization reduces ciphertext size without removing all error. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw term counts and evaluation-key roles around multiplication. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for polynomial approximations. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Nonpolynomial functions need approximation ranges and errors. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare toy sigmoid approximation inside and outside its range. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for modular wraparound. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Modular results must match the application’s representation range. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate toy Z17 arithmetic versus ordinary integers. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for output minimization. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Encrypted processing does not prevent sensitive result disclosure. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare full prediction vectors with aggregate-output needs. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「成本量測」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只報評價時間就是端到端延遲。」為何不成立。
提交「輸出最小化」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較完整預測向量與聚合輸出的需求。」如何辨別它們。
提交「輸出最小化」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「使用 HE 後永遠不需輸出隱私控制。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for cost measurement; explain why this claim fails: Evaluation time equals end-to-end latency.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for output minimization; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for output minimization; explain why this claim fails: HE eliminates output-privacy controls.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：使用 HE 後永遠不需輸出隱私控制。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: HE eliminates output-privacy controls. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
